message: ＴＨＥ・んぱん

name: Misa
message: 「M-Mmmm... mmm~...」
The slightly chilly Student Council room.
Misa and I are working on leftover tasks.
Ria-senpai, Nanaka, and Lolotte have already gone home.
To tell the truth, my share of the work is already done, but somehow I don't want to leave Misa behind and head out.

name: Misa
message: 「The second-best option is... let's see... to do... So that's it.」
It's pitch black outside...
Last month, when we were discussing KiraFes, it was still dusk around this time.
Now it's well past twilight and completely night. The temperature has dropped accordingly, and the windowpanes, chilled by the outside air, are fogged up.

name: Misa
message: 「What else needs to be recorded is... this pending issue and... right, this too...」
Misa is taking detailed notes for the underclassmen we haven't met yet.
KiraFes was a huge success, but there were quite a few small slip-ups and problems.
Our generation can't redo KiraFes anymore. So at the very least, we have to leave a record of those things so the next Student Council can put it to good use.
Misa's really working hard. At a time like this, if it were Ria-senpai...
Alright, I'll brew some black tea. Even I can do at least that much! If I remember right, the tea server we got at KiraFes should be around here... ah, found it!

name: Synn
message: 「Ngh, how on earth are you supposed to use this?」

name: Misa
message: 「...What are you doing, Sakura-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, I was trying to make some tea for you, Misa.」

name: Synn
message: 「Remember that tea server a parent donated for the KiraFes bazaar?」

name: Synn
message: 「It didn't sell, so it's great that I got to keep it and all, but... hahaha, I don't know how to use it.」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph, I suppose it can't be helped. Hand it over to me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry. I ended up causing you trouble instead, Misa. Interrupted your work, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Operating a tea server is pretty complicated...」

name: Misa
message: 「It's simple, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, I see~」

name: Misa
message: 「You're surprisingly clumsy too, aren't you, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Guh.」

name: Misa
message: 「Since I heard a strange sound, I naturally assumed you were doodling on the fogged-up glass.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's mean.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Uh-oh, Synn-sama got all sulky and started doodling on the window...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hisa, make sure you follow up with him properly, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yay, it's the hero of justice, Puritchi Kamen.」

name: Misa
message: 「I get it now. Sakura-kun and I will have a contest to see who has more artistic talent!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's not following up at all!」

name: Misa
message: 「Tea leaves are all set. The time limit is until the black tea is done brewing for two. Ready, go!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, what is that hieroglyph that looks like a cross-section of a shiitake mushroom?」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't it obvious at a glance? Pretty Girl Masked Papirin has arrived!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's supposed to be a human... To me, it only looks like a botched king oyster mushroom.」

name: Misa
message: 「Do you like justice sentai heroes, Sakura-kun? Then I'll draw everyone in the Crusaders for you.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, Nanaka-san, Lolotte-san... and then, Big Sister and me.\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama, Soba, and the angel are just stick figures?!」

name: Misa
message: 「...Hey, Sakura-kun. Do you think Student Council officers from long ago, whom we've never even met, doodled like this too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Probably... I bet they did.」

name: Misa
message: 「I see... In that case, let's do it too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that okay? You seem like the type who'd get mad and scold people for pranks like this, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course I wouldn't do it in a classroom?」

name: Misa
message: 「However, the Student Council room is completely different from a classroom. Yet it's not the faculty room or the infirmary either.」

name: Misa
message: 「I can't put it into words well, but it has a unique atmosphere.」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm sure this atmosphere was carefully built by my sister when she was President, Helena-san when she was our age, and the Student Council members from long before them.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, that sound just now...」

name: Misa
message: 「That's the sound of the black tea finishing steeping. You didn't know?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah...! Even though it's your first time, you tried to brew it for me...」

name: Misa
message: 「U-um... well... th-thank...」

name: Misa
message: 「Paqy-san, judge our doodles! I win, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah! The Great Sage Paqy-sama will give you a strict and fair evaluation.」

name: Paqy
message: 「The result of the match is--」

name: Paqy
message: 「You both lose!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「These are beyond awful. The proportions are all messed up, the perspective is from another dimension--I can't even bear to look at 'em.」

name: Paqy
message: 「W-why are the two of you grabbing the great me at the same time?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gyaaaaaaaaah~!? Don't wipe the window with my body!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey... Sakura-kun's way home isn't this direction, is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「I just feel like taking a detour tonight.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ah, the classic strategy of letting her guard down with sweet talk before turning into a wolf in sheep's clothing. Expected nothing less from Synn-sama.」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha-wha!? Y-you beast!!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not it!!」

name: Synn
message: 「You stayed back late into the night, so your mom and dad must be worried! That's why I--」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, no need to worry yourself. My parents trust me, after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yeah, I'm fine...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-what is it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Anyway, I'm walking you home. It's dangerous for a girl to walk alone on dark roads like this at night.」

name: Synn
message: 「If something were ever to happen to you, Misa...」

name: Misa
message: 「Eh, wait, does that mean...」

name: Synn
message: 「You're a straight-laced girl, Misa. Something like this could happen.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm a single-minded maiden, Misa Barbara Cristelis!!」

name: Misa
message: 「B-Barbara? My B stands for Brigitta, though...?」

name: Synn
message: 「I stayed late with the Student Council today. I need to hurry home.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, sharp curve ahead!! But I hate anything crooked!!」

name: Misa
message: 「'Crooked deeds' and a 'curved road' have nothing to do with each other, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「KABOOM!! I went straight ahead and smashed right through the guardrail. And down to the bottom of the valley I go, tumbling all the way~」

name: Misa
message: 「Where on earth is there a high school girl who can smash through a guardrail with her bare body!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I won't lose. I'm Mosa Major Bull Kurikinton. Even if I'm badly injured, I'll tough it out and head straight home!!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's Misa, not Mosa!! Who the heck is Major Bull!? Why is there a military rank in my name!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, so you're fine with Kurikinton?」

name: Misa
message: 「Okay! Stop the delusions!!」

name: Synn
message: 「It was just getting to the good part, though? Misa's eventful walk home, spanning all 48 hardcover volumes--」

name: Misa
message: 「How long is that supposed to be!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「It'll keep going until we actually reach Hisa's place, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You weren't planning on walking home with Synn-sama anyway, were you?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Keep up the comedy routine back and forth, and before you know it, you're safely at Hisa's house. That's what Synn-sama is aiming for.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why'd you go and spill the beans, Paqy?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, you...」

name: Misa
message: 「Haaah~\s10」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm not walking home with you, but do you want to grab a quick bite to eat before you go?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, did I make your heart skip a beat? Now we're even!」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmph...」
We arrived at the shopping district.
Misa wasn't joking when she said we should grab a meal together.

name: Misa
message: 「Almost all the shops are closed... We're too late. And here I was thinking of treating you for once, Sakura-kun...」

name: Misa
message: 「Do you know anywhere that's still open?」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it okay if it's not French cuisine or kaiseki?」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Of course it is. Even I don't eat fancy food like that on a regular basis.」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Kim-san's shutter is half open!」

name: Misa
message: 「Isn't that half closed...?」
I peer under the half-open shutter into Five-Star Restaurant.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Kim-san, Kim-san. You still open?」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey, Sakura-kun!? Stop that!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Kim-san, Kim-saaan!」

name: Kim-san
message: 「What is it, what is it? What's the matter, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry to bother you so late, but do you have any leftovers? I haven't had dinner yet.」

name: Kim-san
message: 「That's no good. A kid your age has to make sure to eat properly.」

name: Kim-san
message: 「I've got spring rolls and Chinese zongzi left over. Take them with you if you want.」

name: Misa
message: 「U-Um, let me pay for them--」

name: Kim-san
message: 「No need, no need. Just come help out at the shop next time we're busy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure thing!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, next up--」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha... Whaaat!? Don't tell me you're planning to hit up other shops too?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Sorry, Synn-chan. We were swamped today, so all I've got left is daikon and wakame salad.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's plenty, Auntie Shinagawa.」

name: Misa
message: 「H-How much do we owe you?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「It's fine, it's fine, they're just leftovers anyway.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Even if I feed my old man seaweed now, it's already too late... He used to have such a thick head of hair, too... *Sniff*, *glisten*!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, tears of blood.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Still... oh my, leaving Nanaka-chan behind for a late-night rendezvous at this hour?」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san...」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Young lady, you're with the Student Council, aren't you? You're quite the smooth operator, Synn-chan, heh-heh-heh.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's not like that, I tell you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go, Misa! See ya, Auntie Shinagawa. Thanks!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Sure thing. Come back anytime.」

name: Misa
message: 「Geez... geez~! That was SO embarrassing!」

name: Synn
message: 「Spring rolls and Chinese zongzi from 'Five-Star Restaurant,' vegetable croquettes and red-bean donuts from 'Ushida Butcher Shop,' and--」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't just sit casually on a bench laying out food!!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're not gonna eat? I'll take it all for myself then.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, as if I'd--」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'll eat!」

name: Misa
message: 「Listen carefully, let me make one thing perfectly clear: it's not that I want to eat with you, Sakura-kun.」

name: Misa
message: 「I simply don't want to trample on the goodwill of everyone in the shopping district--」

name: Synn
message: 「Daikon and seaweed salad from 'Shinagawa Greengrocer,' and tomato & chicken pasta from the Italian joint 'Nataripon'--」

name: Misa
message: 「Listen to me!!」

name: Synn
message: 「The pier at night is actually pretty warm this time of year, you know? The daytime sun's warmth probably lingers on the water.」

name: Synn
message: 「You won't catch a cold, so take a seat too, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Who would ever sit next to you!!」

name: Synn
message: 「And last is milk from 'Amakawa Milk Shop.' Not warmed by my body heat, mind you--it's piping hot straight from the warmer.」

name: Synn
message: 「That concludes tonight's dinner.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Leave it to Synn-sama, that's a subtly chaotic combo.」

name: Synn
message: 「Here. This bench is big, so it can double as a table. Dinner is served!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll take this side. Misa, your seat's over there.」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph.」
After waiting for Misa to sit down on the bench, I pop the cap off my Milky Milk.

name: Synn
message: 「Cheeeers! May good fortune be with the Student Council and the Crusaders!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ch-Cheers.」

name: Misa
message: 「Nom, nom!」

name: Misa
message: 「Munch, munch!」

name: Synn
message: 「Slow down and eat at your own pace. They're leftovers, sure, but everything's really tasty, you know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... She's just stuffing her face 'cause she doesn't know how to fill the silence otherwise.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sh-Shut up!! I'm savoring it properly!!」

name: Misa
message: 「I always eat dinner alone, so I'm just not used to eating with someone else!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I didn't know, sorry.」

name: Synn
message: 「My family's a bit of a mess, so hearing your place is like that too... Ah, no, I'm not making fun of you or anything--」

name: Misa
message: 「You don't need to worry about it, Sakura-kun didn't step on a landmine or anything.」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, though you have dug yourself plenty of graves.」

name: Synn
message: 「Guh.」

name: Misa
message: 「...My parents are just busy with work, so we can't sit at the same table at night.」

name: Misa
message: 「Instead, we always eat breakfast together as a family. We've been doing that for over ten years now.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, sounds like you've got great parents.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, I respect them.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's why I at least want to get good grades and make Father and Mother happy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, there's a much simpler way, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Try eating dinner together with everyone once in a while. If you do, I'm sure it'll be super fun.」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-Yeah, I suppose so.」

name: Misa
message: 「M-Munch, munch... munch...」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you full already? Guess it was too much for a girl.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's a match, Sakura-kun! Let's see who can eat more!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「Chomp, munch, nom-nom!」

name: Misa
message: 「Guhk!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ugh... ughh... ugh... ugh...」

name: Synn
message: 「That's what happens when you shovel it in so fast.」
I lightly pat Misa on the back several times.

name: Misa
message: 「Ngh... mm! Haaahhh~」

name: Synn
message: 「Ow-ow-ow, why are you hitting my back? I'm not the one choking here.」

name: Misa
message: 「What, Nanaka-san always does this to you, doesn't she!」

name: Synn
message: 「There's context leading up to it when she hits me! Even Nanaka wouldn't just randomly slap someone on the back out of nowhere.」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh? I-Is that so?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course it is, just think back on it.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ummm...」

name: Synn
message: 「Now's my chance! Nom-nom-nom!!」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey, wait a second! Don't try to beat me using dirty tricks!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「More importantly, man. Why'd soba suddenly get brought up?」

name: Misa
message: 「Thanks for the meal today, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you sure this is far enough? My parents won't get mad no matter how late I stay out, so I can walk you all the way to your house, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm not going home just yet...」

name: Synn
message: 「You sound lonely?」

name: Misa
message: 「T-That's not it at all!」

name: Misa
message: 「U-Umm... see, I ate way too much, right? So I was thinking of a way to burn off the calories.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's why I'm going to sprint all the way home!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Great idea. That'll keep you safe.」

name: Misa
message: 「Right!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, see you at school. Goodnight, Misa.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, close your eyes...」

name: Synn
message: 「*Widen*」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't open them wide, shut your eyelids!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, just like that.」
M-Misa...? What is she planning to do?
N-No way, is she going to k-k-k-kiss me? Ba-dump, ba-dump.

name: Misa
message: 「I have a confession to make.」
Ba-dump, ba-dump, thump-thump-thump!

name: Misa
message: 「You know how I said gathering dinner in the shopping district was embarrassing?」

name: Misa
message: 「That was a lie...」

name: Misa
message: 「Truth is, it was super fun, and I was jealous of you, Sakura-kun.」
W-What, that's the kind of confession it was....

name: Misa
message: 「See ya, goodnight!」
Just as she declared, Misa sprints off toward her house.

name: Synn
message: 「Misa! Slapping my back just like that was spot on!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, you were expecting something weird, weren't you? As if I'd ever give myself to someone like Sakura-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「She's fast, she's already out of sight.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, let's head home, Paqy.」
